defmodule CiPipeline.BuildExecutor do
  @moduledoc """
  Kubernetes CI/CD pipeline executor for building and deploying Elixir releases.
  Handles pod scheduling, artifact caching, and deployment orchestration.
  """

  require Logger

  @k8s_api_base "https://kubernetes.default.svc"
  @service_account_token_path "/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token"
  @namespace_path "/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace"
  @max_build_timeout 600_000
  @artifact_cache_dir "/tmp/ci-cache"

  defstruct [:namespace, :token, :build_id, :repo_url, :branch, :env_vars, :deploy_target]

  def new(params) do
    namespace = read_namespace()
    token = read_token()
    %__MODULE__{
      namespace: namespace,
      token: token,
      build_id: params["build_id"] || generate_build_id(),
      repo_url: params["repo_url"],
      branch: params["branch"] || "main",
      env_vars: params["env_vars"] || %{},
      deploy_target: params["deploy_target"] || "staging"
    }
  end

  def execute_pipeline(executor) do
    with :ok <- validate_inputs(executor),
         {:ok, pod_spec} <- build_pod_spec(executor),
         {:ok, _pod} <- create_build_pod(executor, pod_spec),
         {:ok, result} <- await_build_completion(executor),
         :ok <- process_artifacts(executor, result),
         :ok <- trigger_deployment(executor, result) do
      {:ok, %{build_id: executor.build_id, status: :success}}
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Pipeline failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        cleanup_resources(executor)
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp validate_inputs(%__MODULE__{repo_url: url, branch: branch}) do
    cond do
      is_nil(url) or url == "" -> {:error, :missing_repo_url}
      not valid_git_url?(url) -> {:error, :invalid_repo_url}
      not valid_branch_name?(branch) -> {:error, :invalid_branch}
      true -> :ok
    end
  end

  defp valid_git_url?(url) do
    String.match?(url, ~r/^(https?:\/\/|git@)[\w\-\.]+[\/:]([\w\-\.]+\/)*[\w\-\.]+(\.git)?$/)
  end

  defp valid_branch_name?(branch) do
    String.match?(branch, ~r/^[\w\-\/\.]+$/) and not String.contains?(branch, "..")
  end

  defp build_pod_spec(executor) do
    commands = build_commands(executor)
    spec = %{
      "apiVersion" => "v1",
      "kind" => "Pod",
      "metadata" => %{
        "name" => "ci-build-#{executor.build_id}",
        "namespace" => executor.namespace,
        "labels" => %{"ci.pipeline/build-id" => executor.build_id}
      },
      "spec" => %{
        "restartPolicy" => "Never",
        "serviceAccountName" => "ci-builder",
        "containers" => [
          %{
            "name" => "builder",
            "image" => "elixir:1.15-otp-26",
            "command" => ["/bin/sh", "-c"],
            "args" => [commands],
            "env" => format_env_vars(executor.env_vars),
            "volumeMounts" => [
              %{"name" => "cache", "mountPath" => @artifact_cache_dir}
            ],
            "resources" => %{
              "limits" => %{"cpu" => "2", "memory" => "4Gi"},
              "requests" => %{"cpu" => "500m", "memory" => "1Gi"}
            }
          }
        ],
        "volumes" => [
          %{"name" => "cache", "emptyDir" => %{}}
        ]
      }
    }
    {:ok, spec}
  end

  defp build_commands(executor) do
    base_commands = [
      "set -e",
      "git clone --depth 1 --branch #{executor.branch} #{executor.repo_url} /workspace",
      "cd /workspace",
      "mix local.hex --force",
      "mix local.rebar --force",
      "mix deps.get",
      "mix compile",
      "mix test"
    ]

    deploy_commands = build_deploy_chain(executor)
    all_commands = base_commands ++ deploy_commands
    Enum.join(all_commands, " && ")
  end

  defp build_deploy_chain(executor) do
    # Build deployment command chain based on target environment
    target = executor.deploy_target
    env_config = resolve_deploy_config(target, executor.env_vars)

    [
      "mix release --overwrite",
      deploy_artifact_command(env_config),
      notify_deployment_command(executor.build_id, target)
    ]
  end

  defp resolve_deploy_config(target, env_vars) do
    base_config = %{
      "staging" => %{"cluster" => "staging-01", "replicas" => 2},
      "production" => %{"cluster" => "prod-01", "replicas" => 5}
    }

    config = Map.get(base_config, target, %{"cluster" => "dev-01", "replicas" => 1})
    # Merge user-provided overrides for deployment configuration
    merge_deploy_overrides(config, env_vars)
  end

  defp merge_deploy_overrides(config, env_vars) do
    # Allow override of deployment parameters through env vars
    overrides = env_vars
    |> Enum.filter(fn {k, _v} -> String.starts_with?(k, "DEPLOY_") end)
    |> Enum.map(fn {k, v} -> {String.replace_prefix(k, "DEPLOY_", "") |> String.downcase(), v} end)
    |> Map.new()

    Map.merge(config, overrides)
  end

  defp deploy_artifact_command(env_config) do
    cluster = Map.get(env_config, "cluster", "dev-01")
    replicas = Map.get(env_config, "replicas", 1)
    # Construct kubectl command for deployment
    "kubectl set image deployment/app app=registry.internal/app:${BUILD_SHA} --context=#{cluster} && kubectl scale deployment/app --replicas=#{replicas} --context=#{cluster}"
  end

  defp notify_deployment_command(build_id, target) do
    "curl -sf -X POST http://deploy-notifier.internal/api/deployments -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"build_id\":\"#{build_id}\",\"target\":\"#{target}\"}'"
  end

  defp format_env_vars(env_vars) do
    env_vars
    |> Enum.map(fn {key, value} -> %{"name" => key, "value" => value} end)
  end

  defp create_build_pod(executor, pod_spec) do
    url = "#{@k8s_api_base}/api/v1/namespaces/#{executor.namespace}/pods"
    headers = [{"Authorization", "Bearer #{executor.token}"}, {"Content-Type", "application/json"}]
    body = Jason.encode!(pod_spec)

    case HTTPoison.post(url, body, headers, ssl: [verify: :verify_peer, cacertfile: "/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt"]) do
      {:ok, %{status_code: 201, body: resp_body}} -> {:ok, Jason.decode!(resp_body)}
      {:ok, %{status_code: code, body: resp_body}} -> {:error, {:k8s_error, code, resp_body}}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, {:http_error, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp await_build_completion(executor) do
    poll_pod_status(executor, System.monotonic_time(:millisecond))
  end

  defp poll_pod_status(executor, start_time) do
    elapsed = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - start_time
    if elapsed > @max_build_timeout do
      {:error, :build_timeout}
    else
      case get_pod_status(executor) do
        {:ok, "Succeeded"} -> {:ok, %{status: :success, duration: elapsed}}
        {:ok, "Failed"} -> {:error, :build_failed}
        {:ok, _} ->
          Process.sleep(5_000)
          poll_pod_status(executor, start_time)
        {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
      end
    end
  end

  defp get_pod_status(executor) do
    url = "#{@k8s_api_base}/api/v1/namespaces/#{executor.namespace}/pods/ci-build-#{executor.build_id}"
    headers = [{"Authorization", "Bearer #{executor.token}"}]

    case HTTPoison.get(url, headers, ssl: [verify: :verify_peer, cacertfile: "/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt"]) do
      {:ok, %{status_code: 200, body: body}} ->
        pod = Jason.decode!(body)
        {:ok, get_in(pod, ["status", "phase"])}
      {:ok, %{status_code: code}} -> {:error, {:k8s_error, code}}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp process_artifacts(_executor, _result), do: :ok

  defp trigger_deployment(_executor, _result), do: :ok

  defp cleanup_resources(executor) do
    url = "#{@k8s_api_base}/api/v1/namespaces/#{executor.namespace}/pods/ci-build-#{executor.build_id}"
    headers = [{"Authorization", "Bearer #{executor.token}"}]
    HTTPoison.delete(url, headers, ssl: [verify: :verify_peer, cacertfile: "/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt"])
    :ok
  end

  defp read_namespace do
    case File.read(@namespace_path) do
      {:ok, ns} -> String.trim(ns)
      _ -> "default"
    end
  end

  defp read_token do
    case File.read(@service_account_token_path) do
      {:ok, token} -> String.trim(token)
      _ -> ""
    end
  end

  defp generate_build_id do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(8) |> Base.hex_encode32(case: :lower, padding: false) |> String.slice(0, 12)
  end
end
